name: therakeshm/lightweight-seo
description: A lightweight WordPress SEO plugin that adds essential SEO functionality without bloat.

scripts-descriptions.check: Run every gate that needs no network. Run it before each commit.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Check the syntax of every PHP file.
scripts-descriptions.phpcs: Check coding standards, security rules, and PHP 7.4 compatibility.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the real WordPress tests. Needs tests/bin/install-wp-tests.sh first.
scripts-descriptions.check:pot: Fail when the translation template is stale.
scripts-descriptions.check:whitespace: Fail on trailing whitespace and conflict markers in tracked files.
